segs.t: Ni lilali Mwansa aleteya umupila ne fibusa fyakwe?
Ni kwi Mwansa na banankwe bachimfishe mu bwangalalo bwamupila wakumakasa?
Cinshi calengele ukuti Mwansa akaane ukupoka ubupe?
Ukucila pakucimfya ubwangalo bwakuteya umupila, londolola umweo wakwa Mwansa uo aikele ukulinganya na umulumendo mukalamba uwalefwaya ukumupela imiti ikola.
Supawila ilyashi mukulemba ifintu ifyalengele ukuti Mwansa nebumba lyakwe likose ukufika naku kucimfya.
Belenga ilyashi elyo ufwailemo amashiwi yabulilemo.
Mu ncende ya Kawambwa, mwaleikala umulumendo uwe shina lya __________. Atemenwe ukuteya umupila ne fibusa fyakwe nga bafuma ku __________.
Ubushiku bumo, umulumendo umukalamba aeseshe ukupeela Mwansa icipe ico taishibe bwino-bwino ukuti apeepe. Umulumendo alondolwele ukuti ici cikalenga ukuti ube __________.
Mwansa aibukishe ifyo bakafundisha wakwe basosele ukuti imiti ikola no bwalwa kuti fyaonaula umubili na __________ bwenu.
Mwansa atile, “Awe, natasha. Ndefwaya ukuba kateya wamupila umusuma.” Ifibusa fyakwe nafyo fyalisuminishenye ukutaluka ku miti ikola ne fya kupangapanga no kulya ifya kulya __________.
Chipo ali ne myaka 9 mu Geledi 4.
Mwansa ali ne myaka 10 mu Geledi 5.
Tandi ali ne myaka 8 mu Geledi 3.

Topic codes after UMUTWE throughout (#2882); topic titles to the syllabus names the reviewer gave, the same name for every 4.2.2 (UMWAKUSANGA ILYASHI); units renumbered from the second ICIPANDE 7 (= 8) on, so 8->9, 9->10, 10->11; duplicated pp 94-95 and 99 removed; letter type + punctuation; colours numbered; glossary on a new page. Book-wide: Ameepusho/ilipusho, Abaana, Ifilekabilwa ukwishiba, Imibombele Ileenekelwa, mukwikatisha, UKUPANGA ILYASHI.
